# Manifest

The manifest is `manifest.json` at the root of a Run archive (`knowledge/concepts/Run archive.md`): schema version (3 since 0.1.18), package version, run and snapshot ids, estimand, estimator, value function, normaliser, absence policy, partition, backend, model, player ids and the full configuration. Reanalyze (`knowledge/concepts/Reanalyze.md`) reads it to re-aggregate the archive the way it was produced and refuses any other schema version.

Decision: Manifest schema version 2 (`knowledge/decisions/Pipeline decisions.md`).

Source: `knowledge/concepts/Manifest.md`.
